channel.title: US Top News and Analysis
channel.description: CNBC is the world leader in business news and real-time financial market coverage. Find fast, actionable information.

item.title: Iran reportedly weighs attacks on U.S. targets in Europe as UAE severs trade with Tehran
item.description: Washington and Tehran are considering next steps after negotiations fell apart, while the UAE has suspended trade with Iran.

item.title: Target hikes outlook as sales rebound and huge tariff refund boosts bottom line
item.description: Target is expected to report its fiscal second-quarter results Wednesday morning as the retailer offers a window into its turnaround progress.

item.title: Lowe's gives muted outlook as it sees 'pressure' in home improvement spending
item.description: Lowe's reported mixed results as the retailer said it continued to see pressure in home improvement spending.

item.title: Amazon to expand drone service to nearly 500 cities after targeting 1 million deliveries this year
item.description: Amazon has quietly expanded its drone service to more metro areas in recent months after receiving a key regulatory greenlight enabling longer-range deliveries.

item.title: Here’s the best place to hedge severe El Niño shocks to the food supply chain, BofA says
item.description: One country appears to be the best place to hedge market impact from severe El Niño shocks to global food supply chains, according to Bank of America.

item.title: World’s largest olive oil company pops over 15% as rivals circle in takeover battle
item.description: Shares of Spain's Deoleo jumped on Wednesday morning amid an intensifying takeover battle for the world's largest olive oil bottler and marketer.

item.title: Goldman studied where AI is squeezing labor markets. Here's what it found
item.description: Goldman Sachs found that AI is starting to weigh on employment across developed economies.

item.title: Trump pauses 50% scheduled tariffs on Canada for three days, announces 'deal' with Ottawa
item.description: Trump has already imposed a variety of tariffs on Canada and its specific exports, including metals, lumber and auto parts.

item.title: Dollar risks are mounting. Here’s what could weaken the greenback
item.description: Currency strategists flag Treasury risk, softer U.S. data and uncertain Fed policy as key factors that could pressure the dollar.

item.title: U.S. government debt yields are surging at a bad time. Here's what's behind the move
item.description: Fixed income market watchers ascribe a run that began in June to a number of variables.

item.title: Zelenskyy faces challenge to his wartime rule as former defense chief calls for election
item.description: Former Ukraine Defense Minister Mykhailo Fedorov has called for wartime elections, saying Kyiv must restore its democratic process despite the ongoing war.

item.title: In upset, Florida democratic socialist Nixon wins Democratic Senate primary
item.description: In Alaska, Democrat Mary Peltola and incumbent Republican Senator Dan S. Sullivan advanced in the state's unusual nonpartisan primary.

item.title: China’s backflipping robot maker Unitree pops 542% in Shanghai debut
item.description: Unitree Robotics shares rise 542% on their first day of trading in Shanghai

item.title: Jim Cramer says the market is too negative — and that’s creating buying opportunities
item.description: CNBC’s Jim Cramer said widespread pessimism over rising rates, oil prices and inflation is pushing stocks lower and creating attractive buying opportunities.

item.title: Bond yields are climbing. Here’s what that means for mortgages and other consumer borrowing
item.description: Long-term government bond yields have risen sharply in recent days. Higher bond yields push consumer borrowing costs up, sometimes immediately.

item.title: California AG Bonta says case against Meta is about 'restitution and distortion,' not damages
item.description: Following opening arguments in the case against Meta, California Attorney General Bonta said the trial is not about extracting a massive payout.

item.title: Treasury yields pull back from multi-decade highs ahead of FOMC minutes
item.description: The yield on the 10-year U.S. Treasury note — the key benchmark for U.S. government borrowing — fell 2 basis points to 4.686%.

item.title: Seoul, Washington to halve joint drills as Trump reportedly seeks summit with North Korea's Kim
item.description: Seoul, Washington to halve joint drills as Trump reportedly seeks summit with North Korea's Kim

item.title: If AI is a bubble, could rising yields pop it?
item.description: Many stocks tied to the AI trade have soared on the promise of posting ultrahigh earnings years from now, but rising yields could throw water on that outlook.

item.title: Disney-owned ABC files First Amendment lawsuit against FCC
item.description: Disney's ABC has sued the FCC claiming its investigation and early broadcast licenses renewal are a "retaliatory campaign" due to its programming.

item.title: We upgraded Home Depot and raised our price target. It made the best of a terrible hand
item.description: Home Depot reported a very good quarter, executing well on things it can control.

item.title: CNBC Points Pro: Can you buy a car with a credit card?
item.description: Points expert Jason Stauffer shares what you need to know if you're thinking about buying a car with a credit card.

item.title: OpenAI rolls out ChatGPT for Teens experience with 'stronger built-in safety protections'
item.description: ChatGPT for Teens includes a number of educational features and applies age-appropriate safeguards, OpenAI said.

item.title: Nukes all around? A fraying U.S. nuclear umbrella is pushing allies to weigh defense options, raising risk of a proliferation cascade
item.description: As countries take more responsibility for their own defense and nuclear states step back from arms-control commitments, the question of proliferation arises.

item.title: What Chinese liquor maker Moutai's slump says about the country's economy
item.description: Kweichow Moutai's half-year report showed a rare drop in net profit, following the first annual drop on record.

item.title: Nvidia's AI moat is shifting from chips to capital
item.description: Nvidia still has dominant market share in AI chips, but with competition picking up steam, the company is taking greater advantage of another key asset.

item.title: 30-year Treasury yield tops 5.33%, new 19-year high, on inflation and spending concerns
item.description: Long-dated fixed income hit their highest level in almost two decades amid a worsening U.S. fiscal situation and persistently higher inflation.

item.title: Wednesday's big stock stories: What’s likely to move the market in the next trading session
item.description: The S&P 500 fell for a third session as elevated bond yields and oil kept stocks under pressure Tuesday. Tune in to CNBC Wednesday for BlackRock's Rick Rieder.

item.title: ESPN co-founder Bill Rasmussen dies at 93 from the effects of Parkinson’s disease
item.description: Bill Rasmussen, who co-founded ESPN in 1979 after being fired from a public relations job in the World Hockey Association, died Tuesday. He was 93.

item.title: The 30-year Treasury yield just hit a 19-year high. Three things could drive it even higher
item.description: The yield on the 30-year U.S. Treasury has surged to its highest level in 19 years, and some strategists see scope for the move to go further.
